{{Quote|I'll notify the Viceprex of your arrival at once, Madam, ah, Atuarre?|[[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]] [[Major/Legends|major]] to [[Atuarre]]|<ref name="Han Solo at Stars' End">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>}}
This '''Security Police major''' was a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] stationed at the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] detention facility at [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]], on [[Mytus VII/Legends|Mytus VII]]. The [[Major/Legends|major]] had an officious, almost gruff appearance harboring a quick temper. He also carried a black swagger stick. He was the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] assigned to greet [[Madame Atuarre's Roving Performers]] on their arrival at Stars' End, and escort them to [[Mirkovig Hirken|Viceprex Hirken]]. He was shot and killed by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] during the [[Liberation of Stars' End]].
